Description: SupportQuantity records dimensional category but not a concrete unit identifier or declared unit-system reference; this leaves explicit-unit metadata unresolved at any external solver-facing support boundary.
ProposedDisposition: Technical disposition proposed: SupportQuantity now optionally carries explicit UnitSystemRef and QuantityUnitMetadata, and QuantityDimension maps to accepted PKG-02 canonical dimensions linear_stiffness, rotational_stiffness, displacement, and rotation. README documents metadata-only behavior with no conversion/defaults. Evidence: cargo test --manifest-path core/solver/linear_supports/Cargo.toml passed 13 tests on 2026-05-16.
